summary: FDCTech, Inc. on October 6, 2026 entered two substantially identical share purchase agreements to acquire all outstanding equity of Larstal Limited (UK) and its wholly owned subsidiary Larstal Denmark ApS, both FCA- and DFSA-authorized e-money institutions. Base price is $1,175,000 per entity, $2,350,000 aggregate, structured as 10% deposit paid, 10% on change-of-control application submission, $60,000 monthly interim payments, and balance at completion, plus Target Cash equal to each target's regulatory own funds requirement. The Guarantor, AstroPay Global Holdings, assumed seller obligations. Completion hinges on FCA and DFSA change-of-control approvals.
